methods.title: Pair successive powers
steps: The powers of $-1$ alternate between $-1$ and $1$. Each pair of consecutive terms starting at an odd exponent has sum zero. There are $2006/2=1003$ such pairs and no term left over.
stepsZh: $-1$ 的奇次幂为 $-1$，偶次幂为 $1$。从第一项开始，每相邻两项恰好抵消。共有 $2006/2=1003$ 对，没有剩余项。
